stories.title: As AI execs worry publicly, Bill Gates would like a word
stories.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Bill Gates, the former Microsoft CEO turned philanthropist, about his contributions to AI equity initiatives -- and his criticisms of an AI-powered future world.

stories.title: A rare glimpse inside Israeli-occupied southern Lebanon
stories.summary: NPR gains rare access to the Israel-occupied zone of southern Lebanon.

stories.title: CBO says Iran war diving up inflation, puts price tag at $38 billion
stories.summary: Two new, independent reports show detailed looks at the costs of the war in Iran. It's led to shortages in U.S. weapons, supply chain bottlenecks, and a price tag in the tens of billions of dollars.

stories.title: Missed the 2026 Emmys broadcast? Here's a recap
stories.summary: At the Emmys, The Pitt and Widow's Bay took home big wins. There were some beautiful moments, awkward jokes and surprises too.

stories.title: In Florida, textbook publishers are minimizing or removing climate change coverage
stories.summary: The words "climate change" are slowly being removed from textbooks in Florida and from the state's education standards.

stories.title: New to the U.S., he struggled to find belonging. A fellow student changed that
stories.summary: When Teyu Chou was 11 years old, his family immigrated to the U.S. The transition was isolating and confusing. But a fellow student stepped up and helped him adjust.
